overview: The Uttar Pradesh Scholarship Portal provides financial assistance to students from various categories including SC, ST, General, Minority, and OBC for pre-matric (classes 9-10) and post-matric (classes 11-12 and beyond) education. The scheme covers tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other educational expenses through direct benefit transfer to eligible students.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to students from disadvantaged sections for pre-matric education
Support post-matric education through scholarships and fee reimbursement
Ensure timely disbursement of scholarship funds via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
Promote education among SC, ST, Minority, and OBC communities
Reduce dropout rates by alleviating financial burden on students
eligibility: Students belonging to SC, ST, General, Minority, and OBC categories studying in recognized educational institutions in Uttar Pradesh are eligible. For pre-matric (classes 9-10), the scheme covers students from SC, ST, General, Minority, and OBC. For post-matric (classes 11-12 and beyond), eligibility extends to SC, ST, General, Minority, and OBC students pursuing intermediate, graduation, post-graduation, or professional courses. Applicants must have a bank account linked with Aadhaar and complete One Time Registration (OTR) before applying.
benefits: Financial benefits include maintenance allowance, tuition fee reimbursement, and other educational expenses. Non-financial benefits include access to education for disadvantaged groups, reduced dropout rates, and empowerment through educational support. Specific amounts vary by category and course: pre-matric scholarship provides up to ₹150 per month for 10 months, while post-matric includes fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance as per government norms.
financial_support: Financial support is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to students' Aadhaar-linked bank accounts. The scheme covers maintenance allowance, tuition fees, and other educational charges. For pre-matric (classes 9-10), the rate is ₹150 per month for 10 months. For post-matric, it includes full tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance as per government norms, with disbursement tracked via the Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
application_process: 1. Complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the Uttar Pradesh Scholarship Portal. 2. Log in using registered credentials. 3. Fill the online application form for the respective scholarship category (pre-matric or post-matric). 4. Upload required documents including caste certificate, income certificate, mark sheets, and bank details. 5. Submit the application online. 6. Take a printout of the submitted application. 7. Submit the hard copy with attached documents to the educational institution. 8. Institution verifies and forwards the application online. 9. University/affiliating agency verifies student details and course eligibility. 10. NIC conducts scrutiny of applications. 11. District committee locks verified data. 12. Funds are transferred to beneficiaries' accounts after verification.
required_documents: Mark sheets of previous qualifying examination
deadlines: Application window: July 10, 2025 to January 14, 2026 for student registration/online application for session 2025-26. Hard copy submission deadline: July 02, 2025 to January 21, 2026. Final printout: July 12, 2025 to January 17, 2026.
implementing_agency: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh
contact_details: Email: Not explicitly provided | Helpline: CM Helpline no. (as mentioned in Important Links section)
caveats: Aadhaar seeding in bank account is mandatory for scholarship disbursement
One Time Registration (OTR) is compulsory from academic session 2025-26 before applying
Applications must be submitted online first, followed by hard copy submission to the institution
Incomplete or erroneous applications must be corrected by students within the stipulated time
Scholarship is subject to verification of student attendance, course continuation, and eligibility by educational institutions and authorities
